loaders.note: C and .NET loaders inject into msiexec.exe. The initial access vector is not described.

implant.note: C2 can be read from a public GitHub repository. No stage query names the dead-drop repo or the CloudFront hosts.

llm-patterns.note: Kaspersky infers LLM-assisted development from code patterns. That judgment is not a runtime event on the victim.

killer.note: kvcore.sys is not in the public vulnerable-driver name list checked for this entry. The cryptor impact is file encryption plus the consulting-fee note.
